title: Draft attempt
description: On stdout, after a draft: one author agent's attempt, how it ended, how long it took and how many tools it used. Never the prompt, a path or a file.

kind.description: The program (or, for the bridge, the message type) that printed the line.

run.description: One id per invocation (for the bridge, per process), on every line it prints: a random (version 4) UUID.

at.description: When the line was printed, UTC.

error.description: Why the attempt failed, or for a refused draft the refusal's reason alone (as `refusal` in bridge.author.end); null when it succeeded. Never a path.

steps.description: How many tool uses this agent reported as steps. Once it is above 0, no other agent is tried.
